single_seed_and_bootstrap_limits: Single exploratory training seed (seed=42). Paired customer-clustered 95% bootstrap intervals (2,000 draws, seed=123) quantify validation query/customer sampling variability conditional on the selected checkpoint weights only, not training-seed or initialization variance; do not claim repeatable training superiority from query bootstrap alone.
